purpose: Test whether the documented earlier TTS snapshot more closely matches the approved FM voice. Not a guaranteed identity match or proof that this was the original FM backend.

request.instructions: Speak as a gentle, welcoming Modern Standard Arabic teacher for children aged four to six. Use a soft, warm, natural voice with clear consonants and accurate long vowels. Read only each Arabic letter name written in the script, in order. Say each name once. Leave a clear two-second silent pause between names so they can be separated into individual audio clips. No introduction, numbers, commentary, music, whispering, or exaggerated excitement.

evidence.finding: Official model page lists 2025-03-20 and 2025-12-15 snapshots; current undated alias is 2025-12-15.
Public FM code sends the undated model alias. It does not establish the backend revision used by the historical live recording.
Custom voice creation from recordings requires a matching actor consent recording. The existing synthetic Marin clip is not automatically a custom voice credential; this test creates no voice clone.

acceptance: Baa vowel/articulation matches the approved reference.
Meem keeps correct pronunciation with natural vowel duration and lively teacher expression.
Voice is light, warm, feminine and gently animated, consistent with approved samples.
No repeats, robotic/static artifacts or bass noises.
afterPass: Freeze the exact passing model and settings before preparing missing recordings; review generated content before installation.
afterFail: Stop; do not buy retries or silently switch voice, model, spelling or pitch.
guardrails: No key in chat, files or browser.
One request maximum; failed or uncertain outcomes are held.
Raw and playable candidate preserved separately; no game asset replaced.
Existing budget reservations are shared across all experiments.
